intent: Integrate comprehensive app and plugin audit controls, truthful measured score and frozen-plan coverage, per-category evidence, cancellation and recoverable export into the existing Performance lab without requiring an AI model profile.
constraints: Core and probe contracts owned by other agents; no parallel store, runner, foreground service or plugin mechanism.
No change to existing model benchmark score populations.
Show score denominator and exercised/planned coverage together; retain all untested, unavailable and canceled results.
No private endpoint, credential or raw provider payload in audit export.
No remote mutations; parent integrates and publishes.

plugin_contract: AppAuditAliases.appAuditTargetAliases; AppAuditPluginServices.appAuditGatewayProfileEligible; suspend writeAppAuditExport(OutputStream,BenchmarkBatch,InputStream?). Parent integrates the plugin source commit separately.
implementation: Always-visible App audit navigation before any selected-model guard.
Existing coordinator/foreground execution owns preparation, cancellation, resume and retained batch lifecycle; no new worker/store.
Measured weighted score appears with frozen-plan exercised/verified-pass coverage and every outcome category.
Stable per-run target aliases and display-only current saved names resolve by exact typed UID; renames/removals never rewrite evidence or route to another connection.
Audit-only allowlisted export uses the existing bounded hash-verified private artifact and SAF save/retry lifecycle; legacy receipts remain readable.
Model benchmark score populations exclude APP_AUDIT.
